rows.en:
No, it's about the mindset.
You know what I mean, right?
Come on, let's give it everything we've got!!
What are you planning to do next?

The treadmill, I guess...
What about you, Yuuto?
Then I think I'll do that too.

rows.notes: x6: player here and in nml_lis_012, Pinon in scd_com_716.

rows.en:
Not yet!
I'm turning up the speed!!

W-wait a sec! H-how many km/h is this?
This feels faster than a bicycle...
15 km/h. And I'm going even higher!

You can do it, keep going!!
Don't let it beat you!!

rows.notes: x2: male player here and in frd_she_007.

rows.en:
Yuuto, your stamina is bottomless...
That was a bit too much for me.
Still, it felt great once it was over.

I see, that's good.
Mind if I invite you again?
Yeah, let's do it together again.
All right, next time we take on 30 km/h!

(I'm tired, but it felt great
to move all out.)
Let's give it everything we've got!!
What are you going to do next?

Let's see, the treadmill, I guess...
What about you, Kagura-kun?
Yeah, let's give it our all.

You're just too amazing, Kagura-kun.
I worked pretty hard too, you know...
Still, it felt great once it was over.
Yeah, sure. Let's do it again.

rows.notes: Female only; answers the 30 km/h challenge.

rows.en:
(I'm tired, but it felt great
to move all out~)
(I hope it doesn't end up like last time...)

What's up, \p?
You've got a gloomy look on your face.

It's such nice weather,
so let's go all out!!

rows.notes: x4: Kagura here, the player in frd_rnk_007.
Both genders; plays on otsukaresama (literally 'you're tired').

rows.en:
You think so?
Oh well, I'm going to run a bit more.

(I promised to go to Deep Akihabara
with Yuuto today.)

It's fine. I made good use of
the waiting time anyway.

You've got to make the most of
the limited time you have each day.

Y-yeah, I guess.
Well then, shall we go...
All that walking today wore me out, huh.

Yeah. And when you're tired, Nyan-Nyan's
maguro buns taste extra special!
rows.notes: Nyan-Nyan hanten: rendered as the shop name alone.
x3: Kagura here, the male player in frd_luk_004.

rows.en: Hesitating like that isn't like you, Yuuto.
You're a good person, you know...
rows.notes: Both genders: ii yatsu kept neutral.

rows.en: Wh-what's this, all of a sudden?!
Anyway, I'm grateful to you. Thanks.

Well, nobody else can really keep up
with my pace, you know...

No, it's fine.
I'm counting on you from here on, too!

uncertain: c07064 kimi wa ii yatsu da ne is shared by both genders: 'You're a good person, you know...' rather than 'good guy'.
c07058 Nyan-Nyan hanten (restaurant) rendered as plain 'Nyan-Nyan's'.
c07037 'hontou ni tsukareta yo' answers 'otsukaresama' (a play on tired); English cannot carry the pun ('Good work!' / 'I'm seriously worn out...').
